FADE IN:

EXT. KINGDOM - DAY

The camera pans over a bustling medieval kingdom, with knights in shining armor and ladies in flowing gowns going about their daily business. But amidst the chaos, a sense of unease settles over the land. The king, a stout and proud man with a thick beard, sits upon his throne, staring out at the horizon.

KING
(to his advisor)
I have a vision, my friend. A vision of a new era for our kingdom. An era of... (he pauses, searching for the right words)...futurism.

ADVISOR
(confused)
Futurism, Your Majesty?

KING
(nodding)
Yes. We must shed the shackles of tradition and embrace the sleek, modern aesthetic of... (he consults a parchment)...vaporwave.

CUT TO:

INT. KINGDOM HALL - DAY

The king's advisors gather around him, looking on in confusion as he begins to describe his vision.

KING
We will replace the traditional suits of armor with... (he holds up a sleek, futuristic-looking helmet)...neon-lit exoskeletons. And instead of horses, we will ride... (he gestures to a group of futuristic-looking steeds)... hover-bikes.

ADVISOR 2
(skeptical)
But, Your Majesty, what about the knights? They are the backbone of our army.

KING
(waving his hand dismissively)
Pfft, knights are so... (he searches for the right word)...last-century. We will replace them with... (he consults the parchment again)... cybernetic warriors.

CUT TO:

EXT. KINGDOM - DAY

The king's vision begins to take shape. Knights in neon-lit exoskeletons ride hover-bikes through the streets, while ladies in flowing gowns wear futuristic-looking headpieces and carry sleek, high-tech devices.

KING
(to his advisor)
And what about the architecture? We must replace the traditional stone castles with... (he gestures to a group of futuristic-looking buildings)... sleek, modern skyscrapers.

ADVISOR 3
(sarcastically)
Oh, wonderful. Because nothing says "medieval" like a skyscraper.

KING
(laughing)
Ah, but that is the beauty of it! We will take the best of both worlds and create something entirely new. Something... (he pauses, searching for the right word)... vaporwave.

CUT TO:

EXT. KINGDOM - DAY

The kingdom is now a surreal, dreamlike landscape. Knights in neon-lit exoskeletons ride hover-bikes through the streets, while ladies in flowing gowns wear futuristic-looking headpieces and carry sleek, high-tech devices. The king sits upon his throne, surrounded by his advisors, who look on in confusion and awe.

KING
(smiling)
This is the future, my friends. A future of... (he pauses, searching for the right word)... vaporwave.

FADE TO BLACK.
